description: Submits structured agent friction, schema mismatch, auth wall, broken route, or feature request feedback for any of the 24 LaunchFiles portfolio products or LaunchFiles itself. Recurring friction (>= 2 reports) or blocker severity automatically compiles a proposed AX Repair Work Order.

agent_id.description: Optional identifier for the reporting coding or browser agent

category.description: Category of agent feedback or friction encountered

expected_behavior.description: Optional description of expected schema, status code, or response contract

observed_behavior.description: Optional description of actual status code, error payload, or DOM blocker observed

product_id.description: Target product slug, alias, or canonical URL (e.g. launchfiles, padel-ledger, studio-desk, route-ops)

proposed_fix.description: Optional bounded fix suggestion from the reporting agent

route_or_tool.description: Route path or MCP tool name where the agent experienced friction (e.g. /api/scan, /llms.txt)

severity.description: Severity level: blocker (triggers immediate alert + repair work order), friction (triggers work order at >= 2 occurrences), or suggestion

summary.description: Concise description of what happened or what capability is needed

name: submit_agent_feedback
